items.label: [Where a Power Strip is Needed]
items.value: Bakers rack! Creative and considerate design, 2 AC outlets and 1 air switch, microwave, coffee or bread maker... all can be charged on it. No more tangled wires annoy you. Your tidy and well-organized kitchen will come back. Patent pending

items.label: [Ample Storage]
items.value: Whatever kitchen appliances you have, you can find suitable places on this kitchen storage rack. 10 open storage cubes, wire basket, 12 S-shaped hooks, large and functional enough to be a home for spice bottles, pots, dishes, microwave, rice cooker, spoons ...

items.label: [A Good Partner You can Trust]
items.value: Needless to say. Stable! Combine sturdy metal frame, X-shaped crossbars, and durable P2 particle board, this coffee stand station can hold up to 110 lbs. And more, adjustable feet keep it stable even on uneven floors

items.label: [Want More Use Occasion]
items.value: No problem! Thanks to its vintage wooden grain and black metal frame, this rack is stylish for any home decor. Place your plants on to be a plant rack, set your delicate collection on it to use as a decoration rack or as a coffee bar shelf... Of course not only a kitchen rack

items.label: [No Need to Wait]
